== Lore ==
{{Legendary unlock text|This powerful soldier's armor pulses with [[The Mists|Mist]] energy. When you wear it on the upper floor of [[Stonemist Castle]], sometimes your chest aches with pride and agony.}}

== Acquisition ==
=== Sold by ===
* In order to be able to purchase the {{rarity|ascended|ascended}} piece, the equivalent [[Triumphant Hero's armor]] [[Triumphant Hero's Breastplate|piece]] must have been unlocked. Additionally, a [[WvW Rank#World ranks|WvW ranking]] of 500 is required.
{{Sold by|id = 81509}}

== Notes ==
* {{Precursor stat change warning text}}
* Obtaining the ascended variant of this item will unlock two skins, [[Sublime Mistforged Triumphant Hero's Breastplate (skin)|one with additional visual effects]] and [[Mistforged Triumphant Hero's Breastplate|one without]].
* Has 4 dye channels.
* Visual effects (glowing tentacles of light) are only active while the characters weapons are drawn. The tentacles do not appear when weapons are stowed away. 
* Visual effects (glowing tentacles of light) appears in both the Legendary and Ascended quality.
* This legendary armor retains the default visual look of the Ascended variant, and does not unlock new skins when upgraded into Legendary armor.
